svg.text: View: top-down with USB-C on left of case — red stripe (Pin 1) is on the LEFT, next to USB-C
Looking down at the board: Pin 1 is bottom-left, Pin 2 directly above it

g.text: Which ribbon cable wires to connect per device (wire number = pin number)
Module accepts 3.3–5V; 3.3V keeps logic levels native
Pull-ups are on the SEN0253 module
Mount flat on the floor or on a left / right
wall — orientation is set over CAN (0x36)
Only wires 1, 3, 13 and 15 are used. Wire 4 is a second GND (same net). 5V (wire 2) is not needed — the IMU runs at 3.3V.
Plateau v1.0 — IDC 2x10 ribbon cable pinout (standard odd/even row interleave)
